title: Terms & Conditions
intro: These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern Your use of Pulse.Jc (the "Service"), accessible from [https://pulsejc.com](https://pulsejc.com) and operated by Juan Eduardo Castro, Argentina ("We", "Us" or "Our").
By creating an Account or using the Service, You agree to these Terms and to Our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy). If You do not agree, please do not use the Service.

sections.title: A Portfolio Demo
blocks: Pulse.Jc is a portfolio demonstration project built by an individual developer to showcase software development work. It is not a commercial product. It is offered free of charge, and features such as the Pro plan exist to demonstrate how they work, not to sell a service.

Because it is a demo, the Service may change, be reset, be interrupted or be discontinued at any time, and data stored in it may be lost. **Do not rely on the Service for important or sensitive communications.**

sections.title: Eligibility
blocks: You must be at least 16 years old to use the Service. By using it, You confirm that You meet this requirement.

sections.title: Your Account
blocks: Provide accurate information when You create Your Account and keep it up to date.
Keep Your password secure. You are responsible for all activity that happens under Your Account.
An Account is personal: do not share it or create Accounts on behalf of other people without their permission.
Let Us know at [contact@pulsejc.com](mailto:contact@pulsejc.com) if You believe Your Account has been accessed without Your authorization.

sections.title: Acceptable Use
blocks: When using the Service, You agree not to:
Send content that is illegal, threatening, harassing, hateful, sexually explicit, or that violates the rights of others.
Send spam, unsolicited messages or contact requests in bulk.
Impersonate another person or misrepresent who You are.
Upload malware or any harmful code, or share links to it.
Try to access other Users' Accounts or data, bypass the Service's security or limits, or probe it for vulnerabilities without permission.
Overload the Service, or access it with bots, scrapers or other automated means.
Use the AI assistant to generate content that violates Google's [Generative AI Prohibited Use Policy](https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy).
We may remove content and suspend or delete Accounts that break these rules, without prior notice.

blocks: You keep ownership of the messages and other content You send through the Service. You are responsible for the content You send. We do not review messages before they are delivered.

sections.title: AI Assistant
blocks: Replies from Pulse AI are generated automatically by Google's Gemini models. They may be inaccurate, incomplete or inappropriate, and they do not represent Our opinions.
AI replies are not professional advice (for example, medical, legal or financial). Do not make important decisions based only on them.
Messages You send to the AI assistant are processed by Google as described in Our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy). Do not share sensitive, confidential or personal information with it.
The number of AI messages You can send per day depends on Your plan, and the limits may change.

sections.title: Plans and Payments
blocks: The Service offers a free plan and a Pro plan with a higher daily limit of AI messages.
**Payments run in Stripe's test mode. No real charges are ever made.** Use only Stripe's test cards (for example, 4242 4242 4242 4242). **Do not enter real card details.**
Payments and the billing portal are handled by Stripe, subject to [Stripe's terms](https://stripe.com/legal).
You can cancel the Pro plan at any time from the billing portal. Since no real payments are taken, no refunds apply.
We may change, add or remove plans and their features at any time.
